## History

Rusty was a stray cat who was formally adopted by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and brought to live at Patty's Place alongside Aunt Jamesina's cats, [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) and the [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md). Although the [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md) quickly established dominance over Rusty, Rusty and [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) initially engaged in ongoing battles before ultimately becoming close friends. During a visit from Royal Gardner's mother and sisters, Rusty and the other house cats acted rambunctiously, contributing to an awkward situation.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 ch.Relationships P1](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0001), [v3 ch.Relationships P46](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0046), [v3 ch.Relationships P51](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0051), [v3 ch.Relationships P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053), [v3 ch.Relationships P62](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0062), +6 more_

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--rusty.md)

[Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) formally adopted Rusty into Patty's Place following an unsuccessful attempt to chloroform the stray cat. The two share a close bond, with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) taking Rusty's side whenever conflicts arose between him and [Joseph](../character/joseph.md).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 ch.Relationships P1](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0001), [v3 ch.Relationships P46](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0046), +4 more_

- Friend of — took Rusty's part in fights against Joseph  <sub>[v3 ch.Relationships P48](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0048), [v3 ch.Relationships P63](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0063), [v3 ch.Opens P1](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0001)</sub>

### [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/joseph--rusty.md)

Rusty and [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) initially engaged in ongoing battles upon moving into Patty's Place together. However, they eventually overcame their enmity to become sworn friends, even sharing the same cushion to sleep on.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053), [v3 ch.Relationships P62](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0062), [v3 ch.Relationships P63](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0063), +2 more_

### [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/rusty--sarah-cat.md)

Rusty lives alongside the [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md) at Patty's Place. When they first met in their new home, the [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md) quickly established dominance over Rusty, though they ultimately learned to live together.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 ch.Relationships P1](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0001), [v3 ch.Relationships P46](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0046), +6 more_
